harness: Node.js with mocked n8n $input, named-node lookups, and binary helper; no n8n runtime, network services or models called

tests.name: Exactly four workflows; one main and three specialist agents
Credential references preserved exactly by original node ID
All connections resolve; each agent has model and tools; all code compiles
Research input rejects empty and multi-item batches
Extracted table values retain headings, units, year and scope
Complete JSON fences are accepted
Malformed or prose-prefixed JSON is rejected without guessing
Invented quote is removed; rejected text is not forwarded
Missing header/context rejects numeric passage
Wrong table column and numeric mutation are rejected
Unknown extraction wrapper fails closed without crashing research
Analyst input excludes rejected and related evidence
Valid analysis preserves values and derives chart from findings
Unsupported finding/value/quote is excluded and cannot enter chart
Agent-supplied chart labels and values cannot alter plot
Mixed units and periods disable comparison chart
Duplicate chart IDs and invalid chart mode are blocked
Compatible time trend passes with different years
Inline SVG uses validated values and no external chart requests
Zero and negative values create finite SVG coordinates
Writer input validates inline chart and rejects external chart URL
Markdown cleanup preserves complete content, including former truncation phrases
Outer Markdown fence is removed without deleting body text
Unsupported narrative number is rejected
Unapproved citation, raw HTML, image and unsafe link fail
One supplementary research call is accepted and kept separate
Failed supplementary research becomes explicit limitation without retry
Repeated writer research blocks publication after calls
HTML styling embeds inline chart in a complete document
Missing chart placeholder fails rather than silently omitting chart
Main verifies ordered tool results and ignores agent HTML copy
Altered evidence or analysis handoffs block PDF
Missing, reordered and repeated specialists block PDF
Incomplete or active HTML is rejected
PDF error yields failure reply, never success
Real PDF signature is required and binary is preserved
Insufficient evidence yields no chart and honest report
